cartograph.description: Interactive map of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java and Rust projects: calls, architecture, infrastructure (Redis, workers, databases), models, real schemas, security, dead code, duplicates and before/after comparison.
cartograph.cmd.saveBaseline: Cartograph: Save the current state as a baseline
cartograph.cmd.compareGit: Cartograph: Compare with a Git revision…
cartograph.cfg.pythonPath: Python interpreter (3.9+) used for the analysis. Empty = auto-detect (python3, python, py).
cartograph.cfg.exclude: Extra folders to ignore (in addition to .venv, node_modules, __pycache__, build folders…).
cartograph.cfg.autoRefresh: Re-run the analysis automatically when a source file is saved.
cartograph.cfg.databases: Databases to read in **read-only** mode to show their real schema (Data view). Example: `{ "name": "prod", "type": "mongodb", "uri": "${env:MONGO_URL}" }`. Requires `psycopg2`/`psycopg` (PostgreSQL) or `pymongo` (MongoDB) in the Python interpreter. SQLite files are detected automatically.
cartograph.cfg.databases.name: Display name.
cartograph.cfg.databases.uri: Connection URI. Use ${env:MY_VARIABLE} to avoid writing a password in the settings.
cartograph.cfg.databases.database: MongoDB: database name if it is not in the URI.
cartograph.cfg.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
